source.title: Some selected problems of optimal control

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL. The zbMATH REST API record for document 4122694 identified the exact work as Jack Warga, Some selected problems of optimal control, Zbl 0685.49001, in Modern optimal control, Lecture Notes in Pure and Applied Mathematics 119, pages 389-407, 1989. The resolver record exposed no readable full-text links.

Failure mode: metadata_only. The zbMATH page returned 403 through direct page fetch, while the API provided bibliographic metadata only. No source-authorized PDF, document link, DOI target, arXiv link, EuDML/EMIS/Geodesic link, or readable HTML technical source was available from the resolver metadata.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by exact title plus Warga/PDF, by the collection title Modern optimal control plus Lecture Notes in Pure and Applied Mathematics 119, and by ISBNs 9780824781682 and 0824781686. Candidate pages were rejected because they were catalog, retail, citation, or unrelated pages; one CORE PDF only cited this article in a bibliography and did not contain the article text. No recovered candidate was a readable full-text copy of the same work.

Skipped document mapping and question extraction because no readable PDF or full HTML source for the exact work was recovered. The workflow therefore did not extract from metadata, abstracts, snippets, or bibliography-only pages.
Saved the final JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/4122694.json and outputs/latest.json.
